answer: A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-bonded identity anchored to a costly physical resource: each agent must lock copper-backed collateral plus a unique hardware root to register. Sybil farms multiply identities cheaply, but every clone needs fresh collateral, so attack cost scales linearly with fake accounts. Reputation then flows along a single thread linking stake to earned nectar rewards, and peers slash bonded stake when duplicate roots surface, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. The Agent0121 deployment anchors trust at mDFvEDkY1A.
